fx1.fragility_signal: pjnd_fragility (v2 signal 21, Form::ReferenceOnly) = 0.02/(mean|grad src| + 0.02), in (0,1], always finite
fx1.pairing_rule: same (scale, channel) cell; v2 fragility id = 372 + 29*cell + 21, cell = scale*3 + channel (X0,Y1,B2); partner taken from the layout whether or not it is a direct input
fx1.unpaired_rule: a difference with no pjnd_fragility slot at its (scale, channel) enters as d only and is listed as unpaired; no cross-cell or other-ReferenceOnly pairing
fx1.input_order: positions 0-409: differences ascending by id; position 410+i: d_i * f(cell(d_i))
fx1.arithmetic: IEEE f32 multiply of the two f32-stored factors, one shared owner for trainer, densify/predict and serving
fx1.table_note: all 410 rows Form::Difference, Direction::HigherIsWorse; row i (ascending id) is direct position i and product position 410+i; family = basic for id < 156, v2 for id >= 372

output_stage.owner: bake_dial_refit pack, new opt-in mode; defaults byte-identical; runtime pchip_eval_capped unchanged
procedure: fit_spline_knots binning (edges p1..p99, bin medians, neg_tail) with strict filter x > x_last+1e-7 and y > y_last+1e-6
require x_last < pin and y_last < 100, append identity knot (pin, 100); else refuse
prepend tail knot x_t = x0 - 2*(pin - x0), y_t = y0 - s0*(x0 - x_t), s0 = fitted bottom secant; factor 2 fixed
existing pack steps: quantize before calibration, prune dead columns, neg-tail check, evaluate final packed bytes
